mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers a contraction in consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not cross the 3.5% threshold within the 3-month window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in GDP demand proxy (GDPC1) signal expansionary monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined signal does not materialize as expected (FEDFUNDS not declining or GDPC1 not rising), or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High supply growth (INDPRO) and elevated demand (HOUST) in a late-cycle expansion context predict sustained S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The late-cycle conditions (INDPRO ≤ 105 or HOUST ≤ 1500) persist, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The federal funds rate does not remain above 4% for the required period, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment levels (PAYEMS) indicate a strong labor market, fostering consumer confidence and corporate investment, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Employment growth does not occur as projected, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects lower inflationary pressures and stronger economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The supply index does not rise sufficiently or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both demand (GDPC1) and demand activity (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The demand proxies do not exhibit the required upward movement, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
